%1$s (displayed pump model) does not match your actual pump model (%2$s). You are responsible for the consequences! Do not connect the pump to a human body! If the MALFUNCTION screen appears, your pump detected a system error and all deliveries have been stopped: write down the Malfunction Code, tap SILENCE ALARM, then contact Customer Technical Support. If the pump is unresponsive, try storage mode to recover: connect the pump to a power source, press and hold the Screen On/Quick Bolus button for 30 seconds - the pump beeps 3 times before going into storage mode, then disconnect it from the power source. To bring the pump out of storage mode, simply connect it to a power source. This does not guarantee clearing the system error; be prepared to permanently lose your pump!
